messages:
deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT BLOCKED — env-parity check failed for service=model-router. Missing secret key in prod: ROUTE_TABLE_HASH. Release paused.
maya: assigning to me. @tom FYI, we switched route hashing in staging to the new consistent-hash table yesterday.
tom: confirmed — staging overlay has `router.routes.hash=v2` and we rolled the routing config there. prod overlay still on `v1`.
ops: how did staging tests pass?
maya: because staging secret was updated before smoke; prod never had the new hashed table value. deploybot currently only validates secret keys, not their decoded content.
audit-bot: last change to prod secret ROUTE_TABLE_HASH by `infra-bot` at 2026-03-19T02:05Z set value v1.
release-eng: options: 1) hotpatch prod secret with v2 value (needs KMS write), 2) rollback image to router:v20260318 which supports v1, 3) quick compatibility shim to accept both v1/v2 (deploy). Change window ends in 40m.
tom: hotpatch blocked — prod KMS policy requires a scheduled privileged operation. Won't be approved inside window.
maya: i'll prepare rollback PR to pin image `registry/redwood/model-router:20260318-compat`. ETA ~12m.
ops: prefer rollback to limit privilege escalation. Also create follow-up to enhance deploybot to compare secret decoded payloads across envs.
release-eng: decision: rollback and hold promotion until next morning. Update release notes to explain rollback and follow-ups.
maya: rollback command: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-router model-router=registry/redwood/model-router:20260318-compat` — applying now.
deploybot: detected image change; running post-deploy health checks.
ops: tailing logs and metrics, readiness checks green.
maya: rollback completed, traffic stable. Creating ticket RL-5010: deploybot secret-value parity check; RL-5011: runbook for route-table rotations.
release-eng: adding changelog entry: "rollback: pinned model-router due to route table secret drift between staging and prod; follow-ups created."
ops: thanks team, will schedule a controlled reconciliation for route-table values in next maintenance window.
deploybot: thread closed after successful rollback verification."
